name: AXM Studio
summary: One complete 2D and interface workspace with ten focused modes, a searchable beginner-first Command Deck over 84 bound visual actions, editable vector objects, timed pixel animation, integrated UI/UX and skin production, and contract-v2 shared modular Creation Hands.
notes: Studio v2.7 adds the shared Visual Actions contract and a capability-gated Command Deck. Core actions remain visible by default; advanced and specialist controls remain one toggle away. Only named existing Studio controls can run, destructive confirmation gates remain in place, and native source-application shortcuts are not claimed.
